rationale: The sole inherited sense bürgen covers the promised liability for sin; source PrS 77/61 identifies the same occurrence.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 71/116)

data.turoyo: U taʕlo omər: "Gdəbeno kofilo, lə maḥtitulli bu ḥabəs, d mamṭeno u ʕazlo." Kfile lu ḥmoro.
data.translation: Der Fuchs bat: "Tut dies nicht; ich will einen Bürgen stellen dafür, dass ich das Garn zur Stelle schaffe." Darauf verbürgte sich der Esel für ihn,

rationale: First Preterit box; masculine Kfile with overt l-marked agent, enough context to identify the obligation and beneficiary.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 73/23)

data.turoyo: Msəkke u taʕlo, maḥatte ʕaṣro yawme bu ḥabəs. Kfila li pire, əmmo: "Ṭro foyəš gabi, hul d mšaylitu ʕal aq qanyone."
data.translation: Darauf ergriffen sie den Fuchs und setzten ihn zehn Tage in's Gefängniss; da verbürgte sich die alte Frau für ihn und sagte: "Lasst ihn bei mir wohnen, bis ihr den Rindern nachgespürt habt."

rationale: New Preterit box; independent feminine Kfila and l-marked agent, with custody/bail context.

summary: Kfile/Kfila use L-series agent morphology and overt l-marked guarantors, donkey and old woman. The guaranteed fox and obligation are recoverable from the preceding clauses; l-NPs here must not be misread as beneficiaries.

Infectum kkofanno has l+n assimilation and a zero-marked nominal matter i ḥṭiṯayḏəx. The same sentence is already quoted under prs 226/25; the source’s feminine suffix variant does not justify a duplicate.
The nominal kofilo “guarantor” in PrS 71/116 is useful context but is not another finite occurrence or a new Infinitiv box. No new sense or fixed collocation is established.
The matter guaranteed can be moral liability (sin) rather than custody/property. This remains bürgen; the fox’s promise is a character’s claim, not a distinct religious technical sense.
